new_destinations.name: Nadi
new_destinations.coordinates_source: centre of the named place/region (town centre or middle of its spots); to be confirmed with resolve-pin.py

name_evidence.wording: Wikivoyage page "Nadi" (Viti Levu city; base for Denarau, Sabeto and the Mamanucas/Yasawas ferries); Lautoka (30 km) and Viseisei lie inside the span.

new_destinations.name: Coral Coast
new_destinations.coordinates_source: centre of the named place/region (town centre or middle of its spots); to be confirmed with resolve-pin.py

name_evidence.wording: Wikivoyage page "Coral Coast": "a popular backpacking destination between Sigatoka and Suva"; its Pacific Harbour page sits "on the Coral Coast of Viti Levu"; also a tourism brand. Covers Sigatoka, Pacific Harbour, Beqa Lagoon.

new_destinations.name: Rakiraki
new_destinations.coordinates_source: centre of the named place/region (town centre or middle of its spots); to be confirmed with resolve-pin.py

name_evidence.wording: Wikivoyage page "Rakiraki": "on the north coast of Viti Levu, on a beautiful strip of land known as the Suncoast"; Nananu-i-Ra is reached from here.

new_destinations.rank_note: hand check: 4 spots, local base -> rank 5

spots.name: Garden of the Sleeping Giant
spots.bio_draft: Garden: former private orchid nursery of Raymond Burr with hilly walking paths and tropical plantings; entry charged.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Nadi and reached from that base.

spots.name: Sri Siva Subramaniya Temple
spots.bio_draft: Religious site: large Dravidian-style Hindu temple at the southern end of Nadi; visitors cover up and enter the interior, free to enter.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Nadi and reached from that base.

spots.name: Sabeto Hot Springs and Mud Pool
spots.bio_draft: Natural attraction: mud bath and three hot-spring pools in the Sabeto valley near Nadi; mud treatments and massages offered.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Nadi and reached from that base.

spots.name: Koroyanitu National Heritage Park
spots.pin_note: source point is a centroid; resolve-pin.py must find the visitor point (OSM feature) before apply
spots.bio_draft: Park: 35 km2 heritage park around Mount Koroyanitu behind Lautoka and Nadi, with walking trails from Abaca village.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Nadi and reached from that base.

spots.name: Viseisei Village
spots.bio_draft: Village: the oldest settlement in Fiji, said to be where the first Melanesian canoes beached at nearby Vuda Point; a $5 entry fee applies.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Nadi and reached from that base.

spots.name: Wailoaloa Beach
spots.bio_draft: Beach: 3 km sand beach north of Nadi town, lined with resorts and beach clubs; a swimming and sunset spot.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Nadi and reached from that base.

spots.name: Nadi Produce Market
spots.bio_draft: Market: daily fresh produce market on Hospital Road, Nadi, open Monday to Saturday.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Nadi and reached from that base.

spots.name: Nausori Highlands
spots.pin_note: source point is a centroid; resolve-pin.py must find the visitor point (OSM feature) before apply
spots.bio_draft: Highlands: dry-zone mountain rainforest behind Nadi offering nature walks, hikes and off-road tours.
spots.reason: Kept in west region, also a review in central: one spot only.

spots.name: Lautoka Market
spots.bio_draft: Market: large covered produce, spice and kava market beside the Lautoka bus station.
spots.reason: Represents Lautoka (kept as a town: folded into this market spot and the Nadi description, not listed beside its own market).

spots.name: Sigatoka Sand Dunes National Park
spots.pin_note: source point is a centroid; resolve-pin.py must find the visitor point (OSM feature) before apply
spots.bio_draft: National park: Fiji's first national park, 20–60 m parabolic dunes at the Sigatoka River mouth with archaeological sites.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Coral Coast and reached from that base.

spots.name: Natadola Beach
spots.bio_draft: Beach: white-sand beach west of Sigatoka, considered one of the best in Fiji, with shade trees and horse riding.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Coral Coast and reached from that base.

spots.name: Biausevu Waterfalls
spots.bio_draft: Waterfall: 20 m tiered waterfall reached by a 20-minute rainforest walk near Biausevu, best just after the wet season.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Coral Coast and reached from that base.

spots.name: Tavuni Hill Fort
spots.bio_draft: Historic site: semi-restored 18th-century hill fort near Naroro village, with guides on precolonial history.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Coral Coast and reached from that base.

spots.name: Kula Eco Park
spots.bio_draft: Wildlife park: captive breeding of endangered species and environmental education, Pacific Harbour side; paid entry (east of Sigatoka, check central region).
spots.reason: Merged with the central-region entry "Kula WILD Adventure Park" (same place, Sigatoka).

spots.name: Nananu-i-Ra
spots.bio_draft: Island: small island off Rakiraki reached by boat from Ellington Wharf, with resorts, the One Bay beach and famous dive sites.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Rakiraki and reached from that base.

spots.name: One Bay Beach
spots.bio_draft: Beach: white sand beach on Nananu-i-Ra with a rainforest behind and an ancient village; a sunset and swimming beach.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Rakiraki and reached from that base.

spots.name: Ratu Udre Udre Tomb
spots.bio_draft: Historic site: tomb of 19th-century chief Udre Udre, said to have eaten hundreds of people, near Vaileka.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Rakiraki and reached from that base.

spots.name: Navatu Rock
spots.bio_draft: Landmark: rock beside Kings Road in Vitawa village that looks like a man or a woman depending on the angle; one of Fiji's oldest settlement sites.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Rakiraki and reached from that base.

spots.name: Navala Village
spots.bio_draft: Village: traditional bure village inland from Ba, where visitors stay in basic homestays; the source is Wikipedia only, a tourism source still needed.
spots.reason: Traditional bure village inland from Ba; reached by the Nadi-Ba-Navala road/day tours, outside the Nadi span (about 55 km) and over 40 km from Rakiraki.

spots.name: Beqa Island
spots.bio_draft: island: lagoon island 10 km off Viti Levu, base for shark dives and firewalking villages, reached by boat from Pacific Harbour
spots.reason: Inside the span of Coral Coast and reached from that base. (spot comes from region fiji-kadavu)

spots.name: Beqa Shark Reef
spots.bio_draft: Dive site: Shark Reef marine park in the Beqa lagoon, dived from Pacific Harbour with shark-dive operators; the place, not an operator.
spots.reason: Merged with kadavu-region "Shark Reef (Beqa Lagoon)" (same dive site; run from Pacific Harbour). (spot comes from region fiji-viti-levu-central)

spots.name: Navua River
spots.bio_draft: River: Upper Navua Gorge whitewater rafting through black volcanic canyon and waterfalls, reached by road from Navua.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Coral Coast and reached from that base. (spot comes from region fiji-viti-levu-central)

folded_or_merged.reason: Kept town folded: Lautoka Market is the spot (wrapper rule); Lautoka described in Nadi.
